name: sql-column-hints
description: Shows column names inline next to INSERT values, like named-parameter hints in a function call.

commands.title: SQL Column Hints: Toggle Inline Column Names
SQL Column Hints: Show All Hints (lift the editor's per-line hint limit)

sqlColumnHints.enabled.description: Show column-name inlay hints next to INSERT values.

sqlColumnHints.languages.description: Language IDs to attach the hint provider to. Reload the window after changing.

sqlColumnHints.hintPosition.description: Where to place the column name relative to the value.

sqlColumnHints.maxColumnNameLength.description: Column names longer than this are truncated with an ellipsis in the hint.

sqlColumnHints.maxRowsPerStatement.description: Safety limit: only the first N value rows of a statement get hints (large dump files).

sqlColumnHints.maxFileSizeKB.description: Skip files larger than this (in KB) to keep the editor responsive.

sqlColumnHints.skipHintsForRowsInsideSel.description: Hide hints on the row the cursor is in, so editing is not visually shifted.

sqlColumnHints.warnAboutEditorHintLimit.markdownDescription: Offer to raise `#editor.inlayHints.maximumLength#` when VS Code's per-line hint budget (default 43 characters) is hiding the last column names on wide INSERT rows.

sqlColumnHints.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report a problem when a value row's item count does not match the column list count.

sqlColumnHints.diagnostics.severity.description: Severity used for column/value count mismatches.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node test/parser.test.js && node test/extension.smoke.js
